checks.requirement: C++23/latest-Kit target, moc, QML/qrc and Review/production closure
checks.evidence: Root discovery still enumerates the highest compatible native Qt and verifies qmake/qsb/qmllint from the same Kit. YalahooScene retains explicit C++23 and its Gui link; focalDepth adds no platform call/link. App aliases PostprocessEffect into Yalahoo.Music, embeds four algorithm snippets, both PNG lookups and their manifest via /assets, and keeps Release production free of Review source/CLI. postprocess-audit links QtGui for QImage/QPainter and QtQuick for the platform-native public backend enum and initializes QGuiApplication for font-backed crop labels. WIN32 remains GUI executable, APPLE bundle metadata and UNIX origin-relative RPATH remain complete pre-existing branches; tools stay ordinary console executables. No third-party native library or private Qt API is introduced.
checks.limitations: No target compiler/linker run on this platform; complete deployment is R31/R32.

checks.requirement: Numeric lookup resources, endian, logical/DPR dimensions and writable paths
checks.evidence: Only whitelisted area/search qrc names are accepted; QImage verifies exact 160x560/66x33 dimensions, converts to byte RGBA8888 and preserves decoded row zero at UV.y=0, matching source flipY=false. Byte RGBA has no endian or color-space interpretation; existing RGB24 depth and float assets retain endian handling. Lookup textures use source linear/nearest filters without mip. Main and full-resolution Bokeh depth use the same effective RenderQuality target; AO has its independent fractional target. Resize rejects invalid values, limits production targets to 8,294,400 pixels and conservative 4096 dimension, preserves authored settings and reacts to actual Screen DPR. Native Review fixture processes set real DPR and verify window/provider sizes rather than claiming a simulated scale. Product assets resolve through qrc, no working-directory/private music path is introduced.
checks.limitations: SSAA is a Review-only diagnostic with extra internal targets; actual target maximum/DPR/driver behavior needs user runtime checks.

checks.requirement: Depth, Bokeh/SMAA bindings, HDR/ACES/sRGB and backend conventions
checks.evidence: Focus is the camera-axis dot product of entity+(0,2,0); aperture consumes detail and quality once, independent of clock speed. RGB24 full-resolution opaque override covers all shell geometry, reconstructs linear camera distance without backend clip-range duplication and is nearest sampled by 41 source taps. SMAA keeps canonical source UV/offset/search math; only framebuffer reads transform via FRAMEBUFFER_Y_UP, numeric LUT reads do not. All samplers are declared TextureInput properties and Qt owns bindings. Distinct fixed instances implement bokeh-only, smaa-only and their combination; combined HDR dof target precedes source-half-float edge/weight buffers, final Pass has no named output. Preset selection never retargets a live command layout. Unshaded shell bypasses material ACES only for compositor, SSAO precedes DOF/SMAA, one final ACES exposure and sRGB follow; raw diagnostics bypass both. Qt tone mapping is None and QML text remains above View3D. Unchanged snippets bake SPIR-V, GLSL desktop/ES, HLSL and MSL with the same selected Kit; actual generated D3D11 shaders are exercised by Windows images.
checks.limitations: Shader generation is not Metal/OpenGL execution. The actual target capture/resolve and postprocessing driver behavior remains a user validation item.

checks.requirement: Render resource lifetime and business/media isolation
checks.evidence: RenderQuality remains a value member independent of navigation/media and preset tests retain scene revision, camera, detail and lighting object. Three fixed Effect instances and their numeric textures are QML owned; only the selected layout is in the environment. Full depth provider identity stays stable while postprocessEnabled; inactive hidden View3D is not sampled by a submitted pass. Existing AO Loader may deactivate on no-AO preset and has an independent identity. All frame-dependent values derive from the existing camera/entity/palette, no extra clock/speed factor. Review uses four actually submitted frames, framebuffer readback and deterministic fixture state. Existing hidden/minimized visual pause and public QtMultimedia objects remain; no media, device, filesystem scan or network operation is added.
checks.limitations: Long-duration pool/performance convergence is R28; target GPU lifetime behavior has not run on this platform.

checks.requirement: Frozen provenance, genuine GPU gates, full ROI accounting and explicit residuals
checks.evidence: The source harness git-archives the frozen commit, checks the lock and PMREM hash, uses the installed browser with isolated repository profile and denies nonlocal requests. LUT/kernel provenance hashes are checked independently. 105 states distinguish nine viewport sizes/two themes/AA controls, all four presets/three covers, Bokeh and SMAA toggles, raw/final output, exact R07 direct-material 075, and real native DPR=1/1.5/2. Actual D3D11 frames, focus/aperture, projections, target bounds and source parameters are gated. Background and raw linearColor have strict MAE<=1; all five material ROIs retain MAE/SSIM and full difference images. AA changes and partial edge coverage are measured separately, DOF and SMAA must change actual pixels. Unmet ROI/capture targets stay as named R10 inputs with images/metrics, not claimed solved. Production executes the same shading graph without Review and rejects Review CLI. This matrix checks actual file/asset/fixture/shader hashes and Windows runtime reports, then records the manually traced platform-independent call chains above.
checks.limitations: This platform has no build/GPU/audio execution. User runtime checklist is required; Windows screenshots do not represent target pixel evidence.
